featured_reviews.review_text:
Bad Rental experience!
I would like to share a disappointing rental experience related to a property in IC Colony and caution others against availing rental services from Homelife Realty and Ronita Realty.

In my recent experience, the landlord took over 4–5 months to return the security deposit after vacating the flat. Despite repeated follow-ups, Mr. Vishal Jadhav and Mr. Robert Gonsalves from the above-mentioned agencies failed to take any effective action or apply adequate pressure on the landlord to ensure a timely refund.

Throughout our stay, we were responsible and cooperative tenants. Rent payments were always made on time, and before vacating, we ensured that the flat was painted and repaired at our own expense. The keys were handed over two days prior to the official lease end date. Despite this, the landlord imposed unreasonable deductions without providing any valid justification or supporting proof.

Additionally, during our tenancy, we complied with the landlord’s request not to drill holes, which meant we had to manage without installing air conditioners. The overall quality of fittings and fixtures in the flat was substandard, resulting in frequent repairs—most of which we had to pay for out of our own pocket on an almost monthly basis.

This experience was mentally exhausting and financially unfair. Unfortunately, the lack of accountability and support from the involved rental agencies only worsened the situation. I strongly advise prospective tenants to exercise caution while dealing with these agencies and the associated landlords.

The team made the entire experience of buying a house incredibly stress-free and smooth. They are more than just estate agents; I would rather call Mr. Vijay and his team true estate professionals.

The sincerity with which Mr. Roshan showed us the property and guided us was remarkable. He was always available to assist us whenever we needed help.

One aspect that highlights the firm's integrity is that, even after completing all the formalities, they never followed-up for the brokerage.

I firmly believe they deserve a 10/10 rating, which is why I couldn’t settle for just a 5-star rating.

✨Thank you, Vijay Sir and Roshan, for helping me purchase my first home. May you continue helping people find their dream homes with the same genuine and classy approach.✨

featured_reviews.name: Aloysius Parmar
featured_reviews.review_text:
My recent interaction with Hilton's real estate division left much to be desired. While I was seriously considering purchasing a property, the broker's lack of initiative during negotiations was not satisfying. Instead of exploring creative solutions or brainstorming ideas to close the deal, they simply delivered a final message and disengaged.
What's more concerning is the absence of any follow-up on client care fell short of the professionalism which I expected from a reputable brand like Hilton.
Overall, the experience felt impersonal and transactional rather than the attentive, solution-oriented service one would anticipate when making such a significant investment.

featured_reviews.name: abhishek sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a wonderful experience selling my flat with Mr. Mukhi and his team’s help. It was probably the best decision to go with Hilton and not some random realtors in the area, and their many years of experience shows in the attention to detail and deep expertise in every step of the process. Mr. Mukhi is very kind and assists you every step of the way more like a friend. I wouldn’t hesitate to approach him and his team again if there’s a need in the future.

I highly recommend Hilton Realtors!

featured_reviews.name: D M
featured_reviews.review_text:

What was even more impressive that I wasn't in town and only travelled for a couple of days and everything was managed to fit this schedule.
Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: rahul ingle
featured_reviews.review_text:
Non Supportive and rude Behavior.

We called IC Estate Consultancy to enquire about the particular property which they have listed on housing.com. We showed interest to visit the property. The person on the phone said that it is not possible. It will be possible after 15 days. We asked him to show us other good properties. He straight away said that he has nothing. He was disinterested in the communication.

We requested him to remove the listing from housing.com if the property is unavailable. The person from IC Estate consultancy became agitated and rudely replied, "Meri Marzi"( It's My wish/will).

I was thoroughly disappointed to see such behaviour. It is not pro customers. It was thoroughly time-wasting and frustrating experience.

I hope people from the IC estate consultancy Ltd read this review and improve their behaviour. It will help their business.

featured_reviews.name: jyoti maurya
featured_reviews.review_text: So we had rented out a 2bhk in Suryadarshan Maryland Complex IC Colony. During the time when we were shown the house we were told that there are small maintenance that needs to be fixed such as bathroom doors, flush and basic cleanliness. However when we got the space no changes were done. We did not complain but took the responsibility of maintaining it. After our two years after we left the house, owner started blaming us for not able to maintain her house. Nobody was corporative not even the brokers. This is to all those who are/will be shifting to specifically 2nd floor of Suryadarshan building maryland Complex, Please be aware of the owner. Get everything fixed before you move in or be ready to bare to pay for the things that's suppose to be owner's responsibility.
